cases.title: Siemens Automates Invoice Processing with UiPath RPA
cases.statDesc: Reduction in invoice processing time across 15 countries
cases.insight: Siemens deployed UiPath robots to handle 50,000+ invoices monthly, eliminating manual data entry errors. The automation freed up 200 FTE hours weekly for strategic finance activities.

cases.title: Spotify Scales Data Analytics with Tableau for 500M Users
cases.statDesc: Faster insights delivery to product teams and executives
cases.insight: Spotify uses Tableau to analyze listening patterns across 500M users, enabling personalized playlists. The platform processes 2TB of streaming data daily for real-time recommendations.

cases.title: Coca-Cola Transforms Sales Operations with Salesforce CRM
cases.statDesc: Increase in sales productivity across global bottling operations
cases.insight: Coca-Cola implemented Salesforce across 200+ countries to unify customer data and streamline order management. The system now handles 10M+ customer interactions monthly with automated lead scoring.

cases.title: Deutsche Bank Optimizes Processes with Celonis Process Mining
cases.statDesc: Annual savings from process optimization and bottleneck elimination
cases.insight: Deutsche Bank uses Celonis to analyze loan processing workflows, identifying inefficiencies in credit approval. The bank reduced average loan processing time from 14 to 8 days through process standardization.

cases.title: Netflix Enhances Content Strategy with Power BI Analytics
cases.statDesc: Reduction in time to generate viewer engagement reports
cases.insight: Netflix leverages Power BI to analyze viewing patterns across 247M subscribers globally. The platform helps content teams make data-driven decisions on original series investments and regional content strategies.

cases.title: Adobe Streamlines Creative Workflows with Monday.com
cases.statDesc: Improvement in project delivery timelines for creative teams
cases.insight: Adobe's creative services team uses Monday.com to manage 500+ concurrent projects across 12 global offices. The platform integrates with Creative Cloud to track asset versions and approval workflows.

cases.title: Unilever Automates HR Onboarding with Microsoft Power Automate
cases.statDesc: Reduction in manual tasks for new employee onboarding globally
cases.insight: Unilever automated employee onboarding across 190 countries, processing 15,000+ new hires annually. The system integrates with SAP SuccessFactors to provision accounts and schedule training automatically.

cases.title: Zoom Improves Customer Support with Zendesk AI
cases.statDesc: Increase in first-contact resolution rates for technical support
cases.insight: Zoom deployed Zendesk AI to handle 100,000+ monthly support tickets during peak usage periods. The AI agent resolves common connectivity issues automatically while escalating complex cases to human agents.

cases.title: Tesla Optimizes Manufacturing with Automation Anywhere
cases.statDesc: Automation of quality control reporting across production lines
cases.insight: Tesla uses Automation Anywhere bots to process quality control data from 4 Gigafactories simultaneously. The system generates real-time production reports and triggers maintenance alerts automatically.

cases.title: Shopify Enhances Knowledge Management with Notion AI
cases.statDesc: Faster document creation and knowledge base updates for developers
cases.insight: Shopify's engineering teams use Notion AI to maintain technical documentation across 200+ microservices. The AI helps generate API documentation and keeps internal wikis updated with code changes.

cases.title: JP Morgan Transforms Meeting Intelligence with Otter.ai
cases.statDesc: Time saved on meeting documentation and action item tracking
cases.insight: JP Morgan uses Otter.ai across investment banking teams to transcribe client meetings and regulatory discussions. The platform processes 10,000+ hours of meetings monthly while maintaining strict compliance standards.

cases.title: Airbnb Scales Operations with Workato Integration Platform
cases.statDesc: Reduction in data integration time across 15 core systems
cases.insight: Airbnb uses Workato to synchronize guest data between booking systems, payment processors, and customer support tools. The platform handles 2M+ daily transactions across 220 countries seamlessly.

cases.title: Samsung Enhances Sales Intelligence with Gong Revenue Intelligence
cases.statDesc: Increase in deal closure rates for B2B electronics division
cases.insight: Samsung's enterprise sales team uses Gong to analyze 5,000+ customer calls monthly across global markets. The platform identifies successful conversation patterns and coaches sales reps on enterprise deals.

cases.title: IBM Optimizes Talent Management with Workday HCM
cases.statDesc: Improvement in employee performance review completion rates globally
cases.insight: IBM migrated 350,000+ employees to Workday for unified HR operations across 175 countries. The system automates performance reviews, succession planning, and skills-based job matching using AI.

cases.title: McDonald's Transforms Data Science with DataRobot AutoML
cases.statDesc: Accuracy in demand forecasting for 40,000 restaurants worldwide
cases.insight: McDonald's uses DataRobot to predict customer demand and optimize inventory across global locations. The ML models analyze weather, events, and historical data to prevent food waste and stockouts.

cases.title: General Electric Improves Project Management with Smartsheet
cases.statDesc: Faster project completion across industrial equipment divisions
cases.insight: GE uses Smartsheet to manage complex manufacturing projects spanning multiple facilities and suppliers. The platform tracks 1,000+ concurrent projects with automated milestone reporting and resource allocation.

cases.title: Microsoft Enhances Customer Service with ServiceNow ITSM
cases.statDesc: Reduction in average incident resolution time for enterprise customers
cases.insight: Microsoft uses ServiceNow to manage IT service delivery for Azure and Office 365 enterprise customers. The platform processes 500,000+ tickets monthly with automated routing and predictive problem resolution.

cases.title: Pfizer Accelerates Drug Discovery with Alteryx Analytics
cases.statDesc: Reduction in clinical trial data analysis timeframes
cases.insight: Pfizer uses Alteryx to analyze genomic data and clinical trial results across multiple therapeutic areas. The platform processes petabytes of research data to identify drug targets and optimize trial protocols.

cases.title: Deloitte Streamlines Consulting with ClickUp Project Management
cases.statDesc: Increase in project delivery efficiency across consulting engagements
cases.insight: Deloitte's consulting teams use ClickUp to manage 2,000+ client projects simultaneously across practice areas. The platform enables real-time collaboration between consultants and automates time tracking for billing.

cases.title: Ford Transforms Manufacturing Intelligence with ThoughtSpot Analytics
cases.statDesc: Improvement in production line efficiency through real-time insights
cases.insight: Ford uses ThoughtSpot to analyze production data from 65 manufacturing plants globally in real-time. Plant managers can query production metrics using natural language and identify bottlenecks instantly.
